derivation.assumptions: Fixed group, all accepted, all pass faithfulness gate, same positive video weight alpha, nonzero within-group video-score standard deviation
derivation.conclusion: Execution annealing lambda cancels within this group; any fixed denominator epsilon does not change lambda cancellation. Changing alpha may affect magnitude with epsilon, unlike lambda.
derivation.not_claimed: No conclusion that annealing is globally useless. Mixed acceptance/gate groups and resulting future policy distributions can differ. No empirical advantage or novel theorem.

version_uncertainties: Paper3.1 saysSFT6k/RL2k while4.1/conclusion say10k/4k; actual training sample count unresolved
Paper training GPU count and current README SFT launch differ; do not treat either as measured requirement for our8B/V100
Downloaded subproject LICENSE failed; source retained locally, no source redistribution
method_consequence: Execution/content reward combination and annealing already have direct code-driven3D precedent; cannot claim novelty from that alone
Our controls must report raw tool acceptance, final original-task completion, unknown checks and scoring failures separately
Freeze downstream tool models when comparing action learners; published video work explicitly freezes its video generator
Preserve failed/unfinished cases in reported denominators instead of interpreting accepted artifacts as complete scene success
